Useful Franklin starting points

What this tool does

  1. Checks urgency before ordinary routing.
  2. Lets you connect needs across categories.
  3. Builds a practical preparation sequence.
  4. Routes to existing Franklin tools and source-backed discovery.

What it does not do

It does not diagnose, give legal advice, calculate changing deadlines, file anything, contact a professional, upload documents, create an account or authorize payment. Confirm changing legal, health, government, eligibility and schedule details at the original source.
